title: Trout Fishing in Another World! ~With a Side of Hot Oni~
overview: Rin receives an unexpected opportunity after fishing an adventurer out of a lake.

title: Combine Your Friends and Ingredients for a Tasty Rice Dish!
overview: Mouths watering for a taste of real food, Vil's party gleefully welcomes Rin as their newest member. Meanwhile, concerns about the Saintess Summoning grow.

title: War on the Water! Seafood Barbeque!
overview: What begins as a survey mission turns into a rescue operation for a beached orca. That just so happens to be telepathic.

title: The Food Demon Descends! Thou Art Tartar Sauce!
overview: Dungeons aren't supposed to appear without warning, but this one did. Fearing a potential threat to the city, the Guild asks Smorgasbord to investigate.

title: Listen Up, Boys! It's a Dungeon Meat Fest!
overview: A Wild Ox can only mean one thing: meat's back on the menu for Rin and her party. It's a good thing, too, since they'll need their strength to uncover the dungeon's secrets.

title: We Like Conger Eel, but We Love Freshwater Eel, Too!
overview: Rin discovers Gomamiso's true identity and uncovers a troubling clue about the Saintess Summoning.

title: The Muchi Dango on Your Waist! Please Give Me Every Last One!
overview: Rin helps the local church improve their food.

title: Stew & Ikura: "Who Do You Choose, Me or Her?!" Rice: "I Love You Both!"
overview: Smorgasbord looks forward to Merlowa's famous spring salt. Unfortunately, they're about to be drawn into the local crisis.

title: Crispy Solution, Crunchy Reconciliation! 'Cause It's Tempura!
overview: They say a way to a dragon's heart is through its stomach.

title: Hyahha! It's Tartar Sauce Time! (For the 2nd Time in 5 Episodes)
